transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my supervisor thought I should come in. I, uh... I mentioned something to him the other day. Just... been having these thoughts lately. That maybe... maybe my family would be better off if I just didn't wake up. It kind of spooked me a bit, so I said something to him. That's... that's why I'm here.
How long have you been having these thoughts about your family being better off without you?
About... two weeks, I guess. Ever since my daughter left Georgia. She, uh... she went into the military, and... yeah. Just been feeling different since then. About two weeks.
Have you been enjoying the things you usually like to do over the past two weeks?

Not really. I usually... well, I'd mess with my tomato plants out back. Or sand some wood at my bench. Watch the Falcons. Used to stay after church talking with folks, too. But lately... I don't know. I just look at all that like it belongs to somebody else. Just haven't had the mind for it.
Have you felt much pleasure when doing things over the past two weeks?
No, not really. Like I said... I just don't get anything out of it right now. The plants, the woodworking... it's all just sitting there. I don't feel much of anything when I try.
Have you thought about how you would harm yourself if you were to act on those thoughts about not waking up?
No. I... I ain't thought about actually doing nothing. Just... figuring it'd be easier if I didn't wake up. I don't have no plan, or nothing like that.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish lately?

I guess... sluggish. Folks at the plant been asking if I caught a bug or something. Say I'm walking slow... taking too long to answer 'em when they ask me something. Just feels like... like I'm trying to move through mud.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?

I don't know... maybe. Just... my daughter took off a while back. I just keep chewing on it, you know? Thinking maybe... maybe if I was a better dad, she wouldn't have gone. Must've messed up somewhere along the line.
Have you been feeling like you're worthless?

I don't... I don't really use words like that. Worthless. Just... like I said about my girl. I just keep going over it in my head. Telling myself I must've failed her somehow. Like... if I was a better father, I would've done something different. That's all.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

I don't really step on a scale much. But... I guess I ain't been eating. Most days I just gotta make myself take a few bites. Even stuff I usually like... down at the warehouse or at the house... it just sits there. End up throwing it out mostly.
Have you been feeling fidgety or having trouble sitting still lately?

Not fidgety, no. It's... kind of the opposite, I guess. The guys down at the warehouse keep asking if I'm coming down with something. Say I'm moving slower than usual. Takes me a minute just to... answer them when they ask me something simple. Just feels like... like I'm trying to walk through mud or something. Heavy.
Have you been experiencing significant distress or impairment in your social or occupational functioning due to these thoughts and feelings?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. It's... it's been hard to keep up with things. At work, I've been messing up. Making mistakes I shouldn't be making. It got bad enough that... well, one of the supervisors found me just sitting in my truck before my shift. Before the sun even came up. They, uh... they got occupational health involved after that. And at the house... I don't know. The mail just piles up. Bills and stuff. I just... I look at it and I can't bring myself to deal with it. Usually I'm on top of that kind of thing. But lately... just haven't been.
Have you been feeling like you're fidgety or having trouble sitting still lately?

I... thought I just answered that. No, I ain't fidgety. Like I was saying, it's the other way around. The guys at the warehouse keep asking if I'm sick. I'm just... dragging. Moving slow, like I'm wading through mud. Takes me a while just to get a simple answer out when they talk to me. That's about it.
Have you been feeling like you're fidgety or restless?

Doc, we just went over this. No. I ain't restless. Like I keep saying... I'm just slow. Walking slow. Taking forever to answer the guys at work when they ask if I'm sick. My body just... feels like mud. That's all.
Have you been experiencing any thoughts that you are a burden to others?

I don't know about being a burden to anybody. It's more just... dealing with my own stuff. Thinking too much, I guess. 

About my daughter. She, uh... she left. And I just keep going over it in my head. Telling myself I must have failed her somehow. Like... a better father would have done something different. That's all.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your sleep patterns over the past two weeks?
No, not really. Sleep's been about the same as usual.
Have you been experiencing any near-total loss of interest or pleasure in most activities for most of each day?

Yeah. I guess you could say that. 

I just... ain't been doing much. Used to mess with my tomato plants, sand wood at my bench... watch the Falcons. Usually I'd stay after church talking to folks, too. But lately... I don't know. I just look at all that stuff and it's like it belongs to somebody else. Just don't have any use for it right now.
Have you been experiencing any psychomotor agitation?
I don't... I don't really know what that means. If you're asking if I'm jumpy or pacing around or something... no. Just been sitting quiet, mostly. Like I said, not doing much of anything.
Have you been experiencing any feelings of worthlessness nearly every day?

I don't... I wouldn't use that word exactly. Just... been thinking a lot. 

My daughter, she left a while back. And I just... I keep going over it in my head. Telling myself I must've failed her somehow. Figure a... a better father would've done something different. Just hard not to chew on that, I guess.
Have you been having thoughts of death or dying frequently over the past two weeks?

...Yeah. I guess that's... that's why I'm here. 

I just... I've been having these thoughts lately. Thinking maybe... maybe my family would be better off if I just... didn't wake up in the morning. It shook me up a bit. Scared me enough that I... I finally said something to my supervisor at work. He told me I needed to come see somebody.
